detail: Agree: EIA's own table of crude exports by destination (https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/pet_move_expc_a_EPC0_EEX_mbblpd_a.htm, read 19 November 2026) gives the Netherlands 790 thousand barrels a day in 2024 and 862 in 2025; ours 789.9 and 862.1. A secondary source's 825 for 2024 is not EIA's figure.

Agree: EIA's own table of crude exports by destination (https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/pet_move_expc_a_EPC0_EEX_mbblpd_a.htm, read 19 November 2026) gives total US crude exports of 4,093 thousand barrels a day in 2024 and 3,961 in 2025; ours 4,093.2 and 3,961.3.

Agree within the warehouse: the mean of Census's seasonally adjusted annual rates for 2025 is 49.71 billion USD against the sum of the not adjusted months, 49.74 (table as retrieved 24 October 2026, after Census's annual revision of July 2026). Statista, citing Census, gives about 41 billion for 2025: by its implied 2024 figure (about 31 billion against our 34.8) an earlier vintage.
